title: Terminal section rings as tensor-unit global sections
statement: Let J be a site admitting abelian sheafification with a localized monoidal structure, R a commutative monoid object in its abelian sheaves, and U a terminal object. The terminal section ring [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] is canonically ring-equivalent to the convolution ring Gamma R of morphisms from the tensor unit to R. Construct sectionGlobalEquiv by evaluating at the canonical integer section 1; its inverse is the constant-sheaf adjunction followed by the free abelian generator equivalence.

proof.text: Evaluate the abelian tensor-unit map at the integer generator. The convolution unit and product evaluate to the ring unit and product, by the pure-tensor multiplication formula; addition and zero are pointwise.

Compose sheaf forgetting and evaluation, with their explicit strong monoidal structures. The preceding evaluation gives sectionGlobalEval. For a terminal U the constant-sheaf adjunction and the free-ab-elian generator equivalence give its inverse on underlying functions. RingEquiv.ofBijective supplies sectionGlobalEquiv. Empty sites and zero rings are included.
